name: Trusts Root Cluster
description: A leaf cluster trusts a root cluster (Teleport's trusted_cluster resource on the leaf; the root sees a remote_cluster). Users of the root reach the leaf's resources with leaf roles chosen by the role map.

role_map.description: The trusted_cluster spec.role_map: root roles (remote) mapped to leaf roles (local).

enabled.description: Whether the trust is enabled on the leaf.

connection_status.description: The root's view of the leaf's tunnel (`online`, `offline`); absent when not observed.
